text:
Zoe (Growth): Quick sync 10-min plan: "Quickstart Surge" 1-webinar + 3 micro-posts + credit splitplay experiment. Goal: increase 7-day activations. Thoughts?
Arjun (Creative): Like it. Two tone options: "Quickstart in minutes" (tactical) vs "Reduce inference overhead" (value). I can draft two hero gifs.
Paula (Product): Webinar should be a live build + deploy: 15m demo, 25m lab, 10m Q&A. Deliverable: working endpoint + a mini prompt-pack. Give attendees a code-first starter repo.
Mark (Eng): Routing/flagging: add `credit_arm` set at signup (SURGE_NOW | SURGE_AFTER). Tag cohort=qs-surge-may. Emit event when user crosses 2000 tokens in 7d.
lead-bot: Signup form v3 -> 64 regs in 4h, ad creative CTR 4.7% :sparkles:
Zoe (Growth): Draft copy (short + long). Edit any time: 
```
Short A: "Get a working LLM endpoint in an hour. Join Quickstart Surge + claim starter credits: https://redwood.ai/quickstart"
Short B: "Lower inference cost, ship faster. Live Quickstart Surge + prompt pack. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/quickstart"
Long: "Hands-on Quickstart Surge: we'll build, deploy, and measure an LLM feature. Attendees receive starter credits and a prompt pack. Limited seats."
```
Arjun (Creative): A is social-first; B is LinkedIn. I'll make a benchmark mini-card comparing per-token cost and 95p latency vs our baseline. Need 95p numbers.
Paula (Product): Experiment hypothesis: SURGE_NOW lifts attendance by ~20% but SURGE_AFTER drives higher post-event usage. Randomize users into arms at signup.
Mark (Eng): Implementation notes: add `credit_arm` to form payload, e.g. `{"cohort":"qs-surge-may","credit_arm":"SURGE_NOW|SURGE_AFTER"}`. I will push events to analytics and wire routing.
Zoe (Growth): Routing rules (proposal):
```json
{"source":"quickstart_form","tags":["cohort:qs-surge-may","launch:quickstart-surge"],"route_to":"growth-sales","route_if":{"7d_tokens":">=2000"},"fallback":"nurture-path"}
```
Paula (Product): Add: if growth-sales queue > 25 leads, route to high-touch nurture and alert AE channel.
Arjun (Creative): For prompt pack, I'll draft 5 compact templates: chatbot, code helper, doc-summarizer, faq-bot, data-extractor. Small examples with each.
Mark (Eng): I'll provide 50/95/99 pctl latency + per-token cost for the small and medium models by EOD. Also will add the randomization flag.
lead-bot: Analytics update -> creative A CTR 5.2%, creative B CTR 3.9% in early run.
Zoe (Growth): Key metrics: reg -> attend, attend -> 7d tokens, 7d tokens -> 30d retention. Primary KPI: % registrants hitting >=2k tokens in 7d. Secondary: cost per activated user.
Paula (Product): I'll own the agenda + prompt pack. Arjun: assets timeline?
Arjun (Creative): Hero gifs + benchmark card by tomorrow noon.
Mark (Eng): Routing, randomness, and metrics wired by EOD.
Zoe (Growth): Great. Action items: Paula (agenda & prompts), Arjun (assets), Mark (routing & infra metrics), Zoe (ads + tracking). Dry run 24h prior. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
